concept.title: Categories not yet in a group
concept.shortdesc: These categories sit alone in the clustering hierarchy, so the grouping step named no group for them. A person deciding the final structure would place each one.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People experiencing perimenopause, menopause or post-menopause, and their partners.
: People with a diagnosed or suspected eating disorder or compulsive eating, with a few women-only healthy-living goals mixed in.
: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans and other LGBTQ+ people, including young people, and their parents, families and friends.
: People interested in gardening, nature, history, heritage or the arts, including local historians and supporters of heritage bodies.
: Volunteers and would-be volunteers, together with charities, community groups and other non-profit organisations and their staff.
: People who are grieving after the death of a partner, relative or loved one, including sudden and traumatic bereavement.
: Businesses, companies, the self-employed and employers, including start-ups and small local firms.
: People who knit, sew, embroider or do other crafts, from complete beginners to experienced makers.
: Sports and games players, from beginners to experienced, in clubs and teams.
